info.title: com.clodhub/voucher-codes
info.description: Readable bearer codes for gift cards, member vouchers and email verification: groups of characters from an alphabet without look-alike characters, each drawn from a com.clodhub/random-source, and the reading of what people type back into the stored form. Server only.

methods.name: createVoucherCodes
methods.description: A generator and reader of codes in the shape the settings give (the installed settings, replaced by any in `options`). Characters are drawn from left to right, each with one `source.int(alphabet length)` call, and each is the alphabet's character at that index, so codes are as unbiased as the source.

methods.name: VoucherCodes.generate
methods.description: A new code: `groups` groups of `groupLength` characters joined by hyphens (ABCD-EFGH-JKMN with the defaults).

schema.description: Groups of characters from the alphabet joined by hyphens, such as ABCD-EFGH-JKMN.

methods.name: VoucherCodes.generateShort
methods.description: A new code of one group of `length` characters with no separator, such as an email verification code (6 characters, 30 bits). The length is not held to the 40-bit floor of the settings: short codes are for codes that expire within minutes and allow few wrong tries.

methods.name: VoucherCodes.normalise
methods.description: The code a person typed or pasted, in its stored form: surrounding space removed, upper case, spaces and hyphens dropped and the characters grouped again, so ` abcd efgh jkmn ` and `ABCDEFGHJKMN` both give ABCD-EFGH-JKMN. Null when the text is not text, has the wrong number of characters, or has a character outside the alphabet.

oneOf.description: Groups of characters from the alphabet joined by hyphens, such as ABCD-EFGH-JKMN.

methods.name: VoucherCodes.isCode
methods.description: Whether normalise reads the text as a code of this shape.

methods.name: VoucherCodes.withRetry
methods.description: Calls `attempt` with a new code until it returns; when it throws an error that `isCollision` accepts (a duplicate key in the store) it tries again with another code, at most `attempts` times in all (3 by default), then throws that error. Any other error is thrown at once.

schema.description: A function (code: string) => Promise<T>, such as one that stores a document with the code.
A function (error: unknown) => boolean: whether the error means the code is taken.

methods.name: settingsFrom
methods.description: Converts and checks settings given as numbers or as rendered template text; unset and unrendered values take the defaults (DEFAULT_SETTINGS).

methods.name: installedSettings
methods.description: The settings clod rendered at install, converted by settingsFrom.

alphabet.description: Upper-case letters and digits, each once. The default leaves out I, O, 0 and 1, which are easy to misread.

VoucherCodeSettings.description: The shape of the codes generate() makes. They are bearer codes that stay valid for months, so the shape carries at least 40 random bits: groups x groupLength x log2(alphabet length) >= 40. generateShort has no such floor.

RawSettings.description: Settings as numbers or as the text clod renders into the settings template; a missing value, or one still in its {{name}} form, takes the default.

int.description: A function int(bound: number): number returning a whole number in [0, bound), each equally likely.

RandomSource.description: A com.clodhub/random-source RandomSource (the fair-shuffle component's, created with source secure); only int is used.

CreateOptions.description: The random source, and settings that replace the installed ones.

VoucherCodes.description: A code generator and reader for one code shape; `settings` is the shape in use.

InvalidSettings.message: RangeError: a setting is out of range, the alphabet is not upper-case letters and digits each once, or the codes generate() makes would carry fewer than 40 random bits

MissingSource.message: TypeError: no random source with an int function was given

BadSourceValue.message: RangeError: the random source returned something other than a whole number in [0, bound)

InvalidLength.message: RangeError: a short code length is not a whole number from 1 to 64

InvalidAttempts.message: RangeError: attempts is not a whole number of at least 1
